family.description: This entry represents a domain that can be found at the C terminus f fungal proteins such as meiotic expression up-regulated protein 26 from Schizosaccharomyces pombe [[cite:PUB00034710]], Ecm8 from Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Rua1 from Ustilago maydis. Rua1 is a transcription factor and part of the gene cluster that mediates the biosynthesis of the glycolipid biosurfactant ustilagic acid (UA) [[cite:PUB00097885],[cite:PUB00097886]].
family.name: Transcription regulator Rua1, C-terminal
